notes: All JSON-LD removed; the page text, headings, titles and canonicals are otherwise untouched and valid. Known limitation surfaced by this fixture: removing all structured data also removes one of the collector's own page-type classification signals, so product pages here are reclassified away from 'product' (to a low-confidence 'contact' in practice), which means SDE.MISSING_TYPE_FOR_TEMPLATE and SDE.INCOMPLETE_REQUIRED_PROPS cannot engage their product-page population in this specific scenario. SDE.NO_STRUCTURED_DATA does not depend on page-type accuracy and still correctly reports the overall, most important defect.
